title: GRWM: the night I got locked in a train station

scenes.narration: Okay so story time. Last summer I missed the final train home from the coast.
scenes.visual: First-person selfie-style shot, a woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe, looking into a warmly lit bathroom vanity mirror, bare face, soft morning light, intimate close framing, vertical video

scenes.narration: The station just closed around me. Shutters down, lights off, and I'm inside.
scenes.visual: Close first-person shot, the same woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe massaging foaming cleanser onto her cheeks in the bathroom vanity mirror, warm light, intimate framing, vertical video

scenes.narration: I found one security guard, Dave. Dave was not supposed to be asleep.
scenes.visual: Macro close-up, the same woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe pressing serum drops onto her cheekbone with a glass dropper, bathroom vanity mirror behind, warm light, vertical video

scenes.narration: So it's midnight, and me and Dave are splitting a vending machine dinner.
scenes.visual: Close first-person shot, the same woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe blending foundation on her jaw with a makeup sponge, bathroom vanity mirror, warm light, vertical video

scenes.narration: He tells me he's been writing a novel. In the security booth. For nine years.
scenes.visual: Close first-person shot, the same woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe sweeping cream blush across her cheek with a brush, bathroom vanity mirror, warm light, vertical video

scenes.narration: It was good. Like, actually good. I read forty pages on a bench at two a.m.
scenes.visual: Macro close-up, the same woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe applying muted rose lipstick, bathroom vanity mirror, warm light, vertical video

scenes.narration: First train out at five. Dave, if you're watching this, publish the book.
scenes.visual: First-person shot, the same woman in her late twenties with curly dark hair wearing a sage green robe, finished natural makeup look, smiling at the bathroom vanity mirror and adjusting her hair, warm light, vertical video
